e0d7ea803158c275a7346347fb1e02b3f18be34e.summary: Trend Micro TrendLabs blog post, published 2013-02-27, describing BKDR_RARSTONE.A, a remote access trojan first obtained through a spear phishing email carrying a crafted DOC file. It decrypts itself in memory, loads a downloaded DLL into a hidden Internet Explorer process without dropping it to disk, and uses SSL to blend with normal traffic. Its routines include enumerating, downloading, executing and uploading files, and reading Uninstall Registry Key entries to find and silently remove installed applications such as anti-malware.
